title: Implement primary image selection
description:
Add select command logic:
- For each unique (zen_generation, type_id, version) triple:
  1. Group entries by firmware_md5 (same md5 = identical build)
  2. For different md5 with same version: compare string scores
  3. Select entry with highest score as primary
  4. Log cross-vendor differences (different md5 for same version)
- Populate primary_images table
- Depends on: db.py, strings.py
